summary: Describes a forward error correction scheme for the RaptorQ code and its use in reliable delivery of data objects. RaptorQ is a fountain code with more flexibility, larger source block support, and better efficiency than the earlier Raptor codes in RFC 5053.

eli5.summary: Imagine sending a puzzle with extra spare pieces. Whoever collects enough pieces, any pieces, can rebuild the picture. RaptorQ is a clever way to do that for data, so lost packets do not need resending.
